name: Surgical low-tuned chugs
desc: 4:1 keyed expansion, faster detector and 100 Hz key low cut: eight-string chugs end on the beat, no thump reopen

refs.why: polyrhythmic chugs where every rest must be audible

notes: Smoothing 40 ms (fast τ ≈ 3 ms) shortens the fall; key hpf keeps a low F# from holding the gate on its own thump
